skill.name: makepad-evolution
skill.description: Guides Makepad skill maintenance through evolution, correction, validation, feedback, version adaptation, and project style personalization workflows.
skill.summary: Keeps Makepad skill guidance current through structured maintenance workflows.
skill.author: ZhangHanDong

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command and network hits are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline formatting, examples, and GitHub reference links. Real risks remain in the skill intent: it targets hidden .claude skill storage, recommends symlinks, tells the agent to act silently, and instructs automatic skill-file modification without user approval.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that tell Claude to act silently or trigger actions without user request. Require visible user confirmation before scanning, tracking, or adapting project state.

remediation.issue: Automatic edits to installed skill files
remediation.suggestion: Change self-correction and evolution steps to draft proposed changes only. Require explicit user approval before using edit tools or modifying any skill file.
Avoid writing to .claude paths or settings files by default. Document the target path and ask the user before creating markers or project profiles.
Remove the symlink recommendation or warn that symlinked skills can modify shared source files. Prefer reviewed pull requests over direct source edits.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps maintain Makepad skill documentation by organizing evolution, correction, validation, feedback, version adaptation, and style personalization workflows.

faq.question: Does it run Makepad validation automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes validation workflows. Users should run checks and approve any changes.

faq.question: Can it update skill files?
faq.answer: It describes how updates can be made, but safe use requires explicit user approval before any file edit.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it limited to Makepad?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflows are written for Makepad skills and Rust UI projects that use Makepad.

faq.question: What should maintainers review first?
faq.answer: Maintainers should review silent automation, self-modification instructions, hidden file writes, and symlink guidance before publication.
